proposals.evidence: DEDR 1097 explicitly lists Gondi kask- ‘bite’ and Kannada kaccu ‘bite, sting’. These are same-language matches to the selected simple bite verbs; the nursery qualification on Tamil is retained as a limit on claims about the whole family.
